IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI
Civil Appeal No. 88 of 2022 (First Appeal under Section 96 of the Code of Civil Procedure)

Mehta Traders Pvt Ltd
Versus
Sharma Logistics

CORAM: Hon'ble Mr Justice R Verma.

The appellant instituted a civil suit for recovery of Rs 42 lakh towards goods supplied under a written supply agreement dated 4 January 2019. The trial court dismissed the suit holding that the invoices were not proved and that the claim was barred by limitation under the Limitation Act, 1963. The appellant contends that the acknowledgment of liability in the ledger extended limitation under Section 18 of the Limitation Act and that the Indian Contract Act, 1872 entitles it to payment for goods delivered and accepted.

The following questions arise for consideration before this Court:

Whether the suit was barred by limitation?
Whether the ledger entries amount to an acknowledgment of liability?

The appellant respectfully prays that this Hon'ble Court set aside the decree and decree the suit with interest and costs.
